mechanism: Carbamazepine is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that significantly reduces dronedarone plasma concentrations, decreasing its antiarrhythmic efficacy and increasing risk of arrhythmia recurrence.
action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative anticonvulsant (e.g., levetiracetam) or alternative antiarrhythmic agent if carbamazepine is essential.
